intro.summary: Northwest community between 16 Avenue NW and Confederation Park, just north of SAIT, with active narrow-lot infill on a grid of older bungalows.
intro.body: Capitol Hill sits north of 16 Avenue NW, across from SAIT and North Hill Centre, with Confederation Park on its northern edge and 14 Street NW running through it. Most of its original homes are small mid-century bungalows. Many have been replaced by single-detached and semi-detached infills on 25-foot lots.
